title: Running in reverse: Tau redirects mitochondrial electron flow toward neurodegeneration
title_zh: 倒跑：Tau 将线粒体电子流重定向至神经退行性变
abstract: In this issue of Neuron, Li et al.1 show that tau enters mitochondria and binds NDUFS3 to regulate reverse electron transport (RET) in a phosphorylation-dependent manner. RET promotes tau phosphorylation, forming a self-perpetuating loop that is exacerbated with stress and tauopathy.
abstract_zh: 在本期《Neuron》杂志中，Li 等人1 发现 Tau 进入线粒体并结合 NDUFS3，以磷酸化依赖方式调节逆向电子传递（RET）。RET 促进 Tau 的磷酸化，形成自我维持的循环，且在应激和 Tau 病理状态下被放大。
